hard_requirements: Explicitly anchor all human-facing wall-clock timestamps to Asia/Taipei; use RFC3339 offset +08:00 or label Asia/Taipei
Resolve today/tomorrow/date boundaries and recurring clock hours in Asia/Taipei
Require CI process TZ=Asia/Taipei and fail closed on mismatch
Do not introduce timezone-naive datetime.now/today/utcnow or localtime without explicit timezone
Convert API UTC timestamps to Asia/Taipei before rendering for humans
exceptions: GitHub/API event timestamps, Unix epoch, UTC transport, and Git storage remain their defined canonical wire formats; convert at human-facing boundaries without rewriting evidence
External API-required UTC-only cron/runners may encode the Taiwan clock as calculated UTC, but all authoring, documentation and displayed schedule values must be Asia/Taipei
no_implied_behavior: Do not rewrite historical stored timestamps
Do not adjust geometry or product manufacturing calculations
Do not silently re-time existing external scheduled tasks; migrate only with explicit task-level validation
